programmes.amount_note: Investment incentives comprising cash grants, leasing subsidies, wage subsidies and tax exemptions; aid intensity follows the regional aid map and company size, with the highest rates for small enterprises.
programmes.deadline_note: Run as thematic schemes (καθεστώτα) with defined submission cycles announced by the ministry.

programmes.name_local: Elevate Greece – Εθνικό Μητρώο Νεοφυών Επιχειρήσεων
programmes.funder: Υπουργείο Ανάπτυξης / Γενική Γραμματεία Έρευνας και Καινοτομίας
programmes.amount_note: Registration in the national startup registry is the gateway to targeted ΕΣΠΑ grant calls, tax incentives and visibility; registration itself carries no cash award.

eligibility.other_note: Companies must meet innovation and scalability criteria and be under a defined age and turnover threshold to be certified.

programmes.amount_note: Non-repayable ESPA grant for certified Elevate Greece startups, historically up to EUR 100,000 towards operating costs.
programmes.deadline_note: The Elevate Greece working-capital grant cycles under the 2014-2020 ESPA period have closed.
programmes.reopen_note: Successive cycles have been announced under ESPA; the second cycle was launched for startups affected by the pandemic. New calls for certified startups are published on elevategreece.gov.gr and espa.gr.

programmes.funder: Hellenic Development Bank of Investments (HDBI) / European Investment Fund
programmes.amount_note: Fund of funds investing through selected Greek innovation, early-stage and growth VC funds; ticket size set by the underlying fund.

programmes.funder: European Space Agency (ESA) with the national space agency or regional co-funder
programmes.amount_note: EUR 50,000 equity-free funding for product and IP development, plus up to two years of incubation with technical support from ESA experts, business coaching, legal and IPR advice and fundraising support. Some national BICs add local top-up funding.
programmes.deadline_note: This ESA BIC runs its own call cycle with published cut-off dates, typically two to four per year. Contact the local centre for the next deadline.

procedure_steps.detail: Contact the local ESA BIC to discuss suitability
Submit application documents before the local deadline
Tender Opening Board review, then presentation to the Tender Evaluation Board
Register a company in Greece before signing the incubation contract

eligibility.other_note: Business must use space-based systems, apply space technology in a non-space domain, or develop products and services for the space sector. Company must be registered in Greece.

programmes.source_snippet: €50k equity free funding for product and IP development
